Currently
column2: it's not allowed to attach an fentry/fexit prog to another

column1: one fentry/fexit. At the same time it's not uncommon to see a tracing
program with lots of logic in use
prevents usage of fentry/fexit for performance analysis (e.g. with
bpftool prog profile"" command) in this case. An example could be
falcosecurity libs project that uses tp_btf tracing programs.
Following the corresponding discussion [1]
column2: the reason for that is to

column1: avoid tracing progs call cycles without introducing more complex
solutions. But currently it seems impossible to load and attach tracing
programs in a way that will form such a cycle. The limitation is coming
from the fact that attach_prog_fd is specified at the prog load (thus
making it impossible to attach to a program loaded after it in this
way)
column2: as well as tracing progs not implementing link_detach.

column1: Replace ""no same type"" requirement with verification that no more than
one level of attachment nesting is allowed. In this way only one
fentry/fexit program could be attached to another fentry/fexit to cover
profiling use case
column2: and still no cycle could be formed. To implement

column1: add a new field into bpf_prog_aux to track nested attachment for tracing
programs.
